title: Encoding and decoding machine codes
statement: A nondeterministic machine coding scheme assigns a binary string to each coded machine and assigns a coded machine to every binary string. For every coded machine $M$ and every natural number $m$, decoding the encoding of $M$ followed by $m$ copies of the bit $1$ returns $M$.
